Agent.description: One agent of the system: a graph-agents-cli project.

project.description: The project directory, relative to this file.
project.title: Project

client_id.description: The client id this agent exchanges tokens with at the issuer: the actor id the agents it calls see (default: the agent's name).
client_id.title: Client Id

calls.description: The agents this agent calls (names, or edges).
calls.title: Calls

Agent.title: Agent

Database.description: A database server the agents share (enables check SC10).
Database.title: Database

parallel.description: How many projects deploy at once (default 3).
parallel.title: Parallel

Edge.description: One agent this agent calls, with what `peer add` would be told about it.

approvals.description: relay: the person's decisions on the called agent's pending approvals go through a gate here (requester); deny: this agent never sends them.
approvals.title: Approvals

auth.description: How the caller authenticates; default by its auth policy (jwt: exchange, custom: forward, shared-bearer: bearer).
auth.title: Auth

scope.description: exchange: the scopes asked for (least privilege).
scope.title: Scope

allow_actorless.description: exchange: accept exchanged tokens that name no actor (the called agent then lists client:<client_id> in AUTH_ALLOWED_ACTORS).
allow_actorless.title: Allow Actorless

calls.description: What the caller may send: ask (SendMessage), status (GetTask), cancel.
calls.title: Calls

description.description: What the called agent does, for the caller's model (default: the called agent's A2A_DESCRIPTION).
description.title: Description

Edge.title: Edge

Environment.description: Where the agents run, and so the URL each is called at.

port_base.description: Local processes: the agent at position i of `agents` listens on http://127.0.0.1:<port_base + i>.
port_base.title: Port Base

url.description: Each agent's URL, from a template with {agent} (and optionally {project}, {env}), e.g. https://{agent}.agents.example.com. Without url or port_base, the in-cluster URL of each project's chart and manifest namespace.
url.title: Url

Environment.title: Environment

Identity.description: The issuer that exchanges users' tokens (RFC 8693) for the `auth: exchange` edges.

issuer.description: Compared with each called agent's AUTH_JWT_ISSUER.
issuer.title: Issuer

token_url.description: The issuer's token endpoint (TOKEN_EXCHANGE_URL), one for every environment or one per environment.
token_url.title: Token Url

Identity.title: Identity

description: Agent projects that call each other over A2A, for `graph-agents-cli system`. Generated from the CLI's own models: edit those, not this file.

agents.description: The agents, by name (the name their callers give them).
agents.title: Agents

identity.description: Required when an edge uses auth: exchange.

environments.description: The environments the agents run in.
environments.title: Environments

title: graph-agents-cli system (graph-agents-system.yaml, version 1)
